scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @deks-js/document && npm run build --workspace @deks-js/renderer-core && npm run build --workspace @deks-js/react && npm run build --workspace @deks-js/render-preview
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:release && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:browser: npm run build --workspace @deks-js/document && npm run build --workspace @deks-js/renderer-core && npm run build --workspace @deks-js/render-preview && npm run test:browser --workspace @deks-js/render-preview
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run test:browser
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && npm pack --workspace @deks-js/document --workspace @deks-js/renderer-core --workspace @deks-js/react --workspace @deks-js/render-preview --pack-destination artifacts
